review_method.method: Manual visual comparison of each original native candidate PNG and its assigned original reference through tools.view_image. Each case JSON identity/evidence tail, relevant original state fields, original metadata, action recipe and log were statically read. No older images or visual verdicts were substituted.
review_method.scale: PW native captures are 618 x 824; SC native captures are 930 x 1240. Each case declares physical_reference_scale=2. Original references are respectively 1236 x 1648 and 1860 x 2480. The viewer displayed SC references at 1368 x 1824; this was a tool display resize, not a local derivative. Native candidate files were not resized or modified.
review_method.geometry_precision: Coordinates in observations are approximate manual visual readings in native design pixels, not a computed raster diff or pixel measurement. Exact 384-design-pixel SC information-column allocation remains the frozen requirement; it was not relaxed to a range.
review_method.hash_provenance: Every SHA-256 below is transcribed from the owner-frozen module inventory supplied in the assigned input, with case JSON evidence tails used as a static consistency cross-reference. No local rehash was run or claimed.
review_method.intentional_difference_rule: Actual titles, covers, counts and dates may differ. Capability bounds may explain unavailable authorization or an empty migration cache. Root formal triage in this task also accepts truthful content-driven sheet/float height and position changes, including shorter actual descriptions and unlinked/unavailable tracking content. Independent fixed allocation, padding, legibility, control boundaries, navigation allocation and truthful selected/disabled presentation remain reviewable.
review_method.root_formal_triage: The parent coordinator relayed Root formal triage after the original-image observations: preserve raw description/tracking height and position observations, mark them Root accepted content-driven geometry, and do not require copying illustrative sheet heights. The disabled migration start boundary and SC incognito clock legibility are accepted actionable findings for the subsequent repair map. No production, harness, capture-plan or original case file was changed.
review_method.behavior_rule: Appearance verdicts concern visible static frames. Action recipes plus final state support only the named captured state; they are not new execution, physical input, performance, evdev, lease or end-to-end operation evidence.
review_method.closed_reader_rule: No reader case is assigned here. The artwork-only closed-reader override remains in force: no persistent footer, bookmark ribbon, page/status label or download notice. This batch makes no reader acceptance claim.
